name: obsidian-css-snippets
description: Local Quartz 5 transformer plugin that reads CSS snippets from .obsidian/snippets (filtered by appearance.json's enabledCssSnippets, same as Obsidian itself) and injects them into every page, so vault-level CSS snippets don't have to be pasted into quartz.layout.ts by hand.

quartz.name: obsidian-css-snippets
quartz.description: Injects enabled CSS snippets from .obsidian/snippets into every page's <head>.
